name: 44601 · Alliance, OH
findings: ZIP 44601 (Alliance) has 151 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44601 (Alliance) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 12 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.
